services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: A trip to the 1000 Islands is not complete unless you experience it from the water. Whether you want to visit beautiful Boldt Castle or have lunch at your favorite waterfront restaurant, you can explore this unique and magnificent region on your own schedule with a rental boat from TI River Rentals, an Aqua-Mania, Inc. company. 150 HP 4-Stroke Outboard Engine, Bimini Top, GPS, Bluetooth Stereo, Ski Tow Bar, Large Swim Deck w/Boarding Ladder. The third pontoon make these boats more fuel efficient and stable. Seats up to 13 People. A $2,500 Security Deposit will be run as an authorization only on a credit card at time of pick up in case of damage (renter will be responsible for ANY & ALL
